summary: Eva Live Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an Equity Purchase Agreement dated September 17, 2026 with Hudson Global Ventures, LLC, a Nevada investor, establishing a $10,000,000 standby equity purchase facility. The Company may, but is not obligated to, issue put notices for common stock at a fixed $2.00 per share, minimum $15,000 per put, subject to volume limits and a 7,994,828-share exchange cap absent shareholder approval under Nasdaq Rule 5635(d). A related Registration Rights Agreement requires a resale registration statement within 30 days. Conditions include listing, DWAC eligibility and no DTC chill. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation; watch dilution and resale overhang.
